{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the correct column name for baseline biomarker
col_name = 'biomarker_baseline'

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) which may indicate missing data
print("Sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) in biomarker_baseline:", (trial_df[col_name] == -999.0).sum())

# Check for negative values (other than sentinel)
print("Other negative values in biomarker_baseline:", (trial_df[col_name] < 0).sum())

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value, excluding sentinel values
mean_value = trial_df.loc[trial_df[col_name] != -999.0, col_name].mean()

print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {mean_value}")

# Check if any other values are implausible
print("\nValues outside plausible range (e.g., < 0 or > 200):")
outliers = trial_df[col_name].between(0, 200, inclusive='both')
print(f"Within 0-200 range: {outliers.sum()} out of {len(trial_df)}")"}
